# AMAUTA Spanish School

> Spanish language school in Peru offering immersive courses in Cusco, Lima, and Arequipa with cultural experiences including Machu Picchu and Inca heritage exploration.

AMAUTA Spanish provides Spanish language instruction aligned with Instituto Cervantes standards, combined with homestay accommodation, adventure activities like the Salkantay Trek, and traveling classroom programs throughout Peru. The school offers specialized programs for university students and families, with comprehensive cultural immersion in Quechua-speaking Andean communities.

## Key Topics

- Spanish language courses
- Cusco and Lima locations
- Machu Picchu excursions
- Homestay accommodation
- Inca culture and history
- Travelling Classroom program
- Peruvian festivals and traditions
- Quechua language
- Salkantay Trek adventures
- Instituto Cervantes methodology
- Study abroad programs
- Grammar exercises (Elementary to Intermediate)
- University credit options
- Arequipa Spanish courses

## Spanish Courses & Programs

- [Travelling Classroom Peru](https://www.amautaspanish.com/spanish-courses/travelling-classroom): Traveling Spanish immersion program across Lima, Cusco, and Sacred Valley
- [Travelling Classroom Peru (ES)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/es/cursos-de-espanol/travelling-classroom): Spanish immersion program traveling through Lima, Cusco, and Machu Picchu
- [Spanish for University Students](https://www.amautaspanish.com/es/cursos-de-espanol/especializados/estudiantes-universitarios): Study abroad program for university students with academic credit options
- [Spanish Courses & Adventure](https://www.amautaspanish.com/de/sprachkurse-spanisch-in-peru/abenteuer): Spanish courses combined with adventure activities and Salkantay Trek
- [One-Day Spanish & Culture Itinerary](https://www.amautaspanish.com/de/sprachkurse-spanisch-in-peru/itinerary): One-day Spanish course itinerary in Cusco with cultural market visit
- [Teaching Methodology](https://www.amautaspanish.com/de/uber-uns/unsere-unterrichtsmethode): AMAUTA's interactive teaching methodology aligned with Instituto Cervantes

## About Peru & Culture

- [All About Peru](https://www.amautaspanish.com/about-peru): Overview of Peru's history, culture, demographics, and Inca heritage
- [Peru Festivals & Holidays](https://www.amautaspanish.com/es/sobre-peru/festividades): Complete calendar of Peru's traditional festivals and national holidays
- [Peru History](https://www.amautaspanish.com/de/peru-info/geschichte): Peru's history from pre-Inca civilizations through Spanish conquest
- [Peru Culture & Society (NL)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/nl/peru-info/cultuur-en-maatschappij): Peru's indigenous culture, Quechua language, and Andean traditions
- [About Peru (PT)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/pt/sobre-peru): Peru overview covering history, Inca culture, and tourism information

## Spanish Grammar Exercises

- [Pretérito Simple - Irregular Verbs (Elementary)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/spanish-exercises/elementary/preterito-simple-irregulares/10): Elementary Spanish grammar exercises on irregular Pretérito Simple verbs
- [Past Participle Exercises (Intermediate)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/spanish-exercises/intermediate-i/el-participio-pasado/1): Intermediate Spanish exercises on past participle verb conjugation
- [Direct Object Pronouns (Intermediate)](https://www.amautaspanish.com/spanish-exercises/intermediate-i/pronombres-de-objeto-directo/1): Intermediate exercises on Spanish direct object pronouns placement
